Man's best friend is the dog.

For your stir-fry, a good alternative to soy sauce that provides a similar savory, umami flavor without soy is coconut aminos. It has a slightly sweeter and less salty profile than soy sauce but works well in stir-fries. Another option is tamari if the allergy is strictly to soy protein but not gluten, though since the allergy is to soy, coconut aminos is the safer bet. You can also use a mixture of beef or vegetable broth with a dash of balsamic vinegar or Worcestershire sauce (check for anchovy/soy content) to mimic the depth of flavor.
